label: UI story

kinds.title: Opening card: what the tour is about.
kinds.ui: One app screen drawn live (dashboard, table, detail or form) showing a real task.
kinds.beat: A full-screen message between screens: one idea with a morphing icon.
kinds.shot: A real screenshot from the project assets in the app window, with zoom, cursor and click.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

fields.zoom: assistant zooms into the assistant panel; none shows the whole app.
fields.logo: false keeps the brand logo off this title card, e.g. when the film shows its logo only at the end. Default true.
fields.stat: An optional number on the beat: { "value": 3, "unit": "x", "format": "int" }.
fields.beat.icon: An icon for this idea. It morphs from the previous beat's icon.
fields.cta.icon: The icon the closing card ends on; it morphs from the last beat.

description: A software tour drawn as live, animated UI instead of screenshots: an app shell with a nav rail, dashboards whose numbers count up, tables that cascade in, record detail pages with actions, new-record forms that fill themselves in, an assistant panel with typed questions and approvals, and full-screen beat scenes where one SVG icon morphs from idea to idea. Shot scenes put a real screenshot from the project assets in the same window, with camera zoom, cursor, click and highlight. Subtitles follow the voice word by word.

title.title: Meet the console
title.subtitle: Every customer task in one place

app: script.app = { name, search, nav: [{ label, icon: home|users|cart|receipt|repeat|clock|check|chat|gear }] }

data.dashboard: { heading, sub, kpis: [{ label, value: number, format: int|money|pct, tone: brand|warn|bad|teal, spark?: [numbers], ring?: [{ label, value }] }], queue: { title, rows: [{ chip, tone, title, detail }] }, side: { title, rows: [{ label, sub, value }] } }
data.table: { heading, sub?, filters: [text], columns: [text], rows: [[ text | { text, link } | { badge, tone } | { button } ]], footer? }
data.detail: { title, sub, badge?: { text, tone }, actions: [label], primary?: index, cards: [{ title, rows: [{ label, value }] }], table?: { title, columns, rows }, click?: { action: index, badge?: { text, tone }, toast } }
data.form: { heading, sub, modal?: true, sections: [{ title, fields: [{ label, value, placeholder? }] }], search?: { label, query, result, resultSub, line: [cells] }, lines?: { title, columns, rows }, totals?: [{ label, from, value, format }], reason?: text, submit: { label, busy, toast } }

assistantTurns: assistant.turns: [{ type: suggestions, items, pick } | { type: user, text } | { type: answer, text, source?, rows?: [{ label, value }], analytics?: { title, kpis: [{ label, value, format, change }], series: [numbers], bars: [{ name, valueText, fraction, change }] }, approval?: { summary, facts: [{ label, value }], note, approve: true }, result?: { text, rows } }]

shots.fields: asset (png in project assets), focus {x,y,w,h} in image pixels or null for the full screen, cursor {x,y} optional, click true|false, highlight true|false, cue (optional: one word of the voice line; the shot starts as the voice says it, e.g. "skip")

beat: beat scenes: { kind: beat, kicker?, title, subtitle?, icon: motion-kit name, stat?: { value, unit, format }, decor?: walls|waves|none, check?: true }. The icon is shared: each beat morphs it from the previous one, and a cta with icon ends on it.
